blindnessAndScope.independenceRule: Only sequence or route is treated as an independent inferential unit. Frames, points, and object boxes are repeated observations within a sequence.

sourcesReopened.reopenMethod: public formal paper URL reopened during this audit; only paper-level facts below are treated as verified
factsUsed: V2U4Real is the formal CVPR 2026 paper.
The paper reports a real-world vehicle-to-UAV cooperative perception dataset, aggregate single-agent and cooperative baselines, distance analyses, and synchronous/asynchronous benchmark conditions.

sourcesReopened.reopenMethod: the indexed formal supplement was reopened during the audit and independently rechecked by exact Table 7 queries; split and frame counts below are supplement-table facts
factsUsed: Supplementary Table 7 lists 42 public sequences split into 24 train, 9 validation, and 9 test sequences.
The listed sequence frame counts sum to 33544 train, 9896 validation, 10544 test, and 53984 total frames in the public split table.
The main paper states more than 56K LiDAR frames and more than 700K 3D bounding boxes; these are dataset-scale observations, not independent samples.

The supplement states that onboard computers share GPS time, LiDAR and cameras use PTP/PPS synchronization, temporally closest vehicle/UAV LiDAR frames are paired, and inter-agent discrepancy is kept within 20 ms.
The main paper defines asynchronous evaluation using an artificial (0, 1000] ms delay, not measured public network-delay traces.
The paper reports distance and sync/async results directly, so those are occupied controls rather than the candidate residual.

sourcesReopened.reopenMethod: the arXiv record was reopened to preserve the preprint destination alongside the formal CVPR record
factsUsed: The arXiv record identifies the same title and authors and points to the official V2U4Real codebase.

The complete, non-truncated fixed-commit tree contains 227 entries, including the public base loader, inference entry point, early/late/intermediate fusion configs, Where2Comm, CoAlign, and visualization config.
The fixed README specifies split/scenario/agent/timestamp organization: agent 1 is vehicle-side, agent 2 is UAV-side, and matching numeric stems index YAML metadata, PCD, and images.

The fixed loader indexes scenario_database by scenario, cav_id, and timestamp; loads lidar_pose and raw delayed LiDAR; calculates distance to ego; emits time_delay; and uses current-timestamp ground truth with delayed cooperative input for evaluation.
The README publishes inference commands and vehicle-only, UAV-only, and cooperative benchmark/model-zoo entries.
These are source-level feasibility facts only. No checkpoint payload, Hugging Face sample, complete sequence, three-arm sequence output, or end-to-end run was treated as executable evidence.
The fixed official README links this Hugging Face repository as the public data release.
The Hugging Face tree API request timed out, so no dataset-tree listing, YAML metadata, or sample file was promoted to verified evidence.
No complete dataset was downloaded, consistent with the 95 GB download prohibition.

formalVenue.value: CVPR 2026 formal Open Access paper for V2U4Real

lidarFrames.value: more than 56K LiDAR frames in the paper; supplementary public sequence table sums to 53984 frames across 42 listed sequences

independenceBoundary.value: Frames and boxes are repeated observations; they cannot be used as independent n for inference.

vehicleAgent.value: The fixed README identifies agent directory 1 as vehicle-side and publishes a vehicle-only No Fusion benchmark.

uavAgent.value: The fixed README identifies agent directory 2 as UAV-side and publishes a UAV-only No Fusion benchmark.

sameTimestampPairingFields.value: The fixed README and loader verify scenario/cav/timestamp hierarchy, matching numeric stems, vehicle/UAV agent paths, lidar_pose, and current-versus-delayed frame selection. The loader calls the stems mocked timestamps and assumes all CAVs have the same timestamp length, so actual cross-agent timestamp deltas, missing-frame behavior, Hugging Face YAML contents, object/track identifiers, and a sampled sequence remain unverified.

sync.value: Synchronized V2U pairs are constructed from hardware-synchronized streams by selecting vehicle and UAV frames with minimum timestamp difference.

async.value: Asynchronous evaluation applies an artificial delay in (0, 1000] ms, not a measured public network-delay trace.

noveltyBoundary.value: Distance and sync/async effects are already covered by the V2U4Real paper and cannot be the candidate's new contribution.

smallMetadataAvailability.value: The fixed GitHub README, complete 227-entry source tree, and base loader were fetched as small artifacts. They expose the expected split/scenario/agent/timestamp schema, but the Hugging Face tree request timed out and no actual dataset YAML, small sequence sample, or file hash was obtained.

scenarioSequenceBoundary.value: The main paper says 44 representative scenarios were selected, while Supplementary Table 7 enumerates 42 train/validation/test sequences. Scenario and sequence are not assumed to be one-to-one, and the power analysis uses only the 42 enumerated sequences.

vehicleOnly.finding: The main paper reports a vehicle-only No Fusion arm in the same shared ground-truth space; file-level sequence outputs and the exact public config remain unverified.

uavOnly.finding: The main paper reports a UAV-only No Fusion arm in the same shared ground-truth space; file-level sequence outputs and the exact public config remain unverified.

cooperative.finding: The main paper reports early, late, and intermediate cooperative baselines on the same benchmark; file-level sequence outputs, configs, and checkpoint payloads remain unverified.

sameSceneTimestampObjectPairing.finding: The paper establishes synchronized timestamp pairing and consistent track identities, while the fixed README and loader verify split/scenario/agent/timestamp paths, matching filename stems, lidar_pose, current ground truth, and delayed cooperative inputs. The source loader nevertheless assumes equal per-agent timestamp lengths and uses mocked timestamp keys. The ledger is not closed because no actual Hugging Face YAML/sample, missing-frame case, physical timestamp delta, or same-sequence outputs from all three trained arms were inspected.

verifiedFields: matching numeric timestamp stems across vehicle and UAV paths
synthetic time_delay and current-versus-delayed timestamp relation
unknownFields: receiver-only occlusion proxy computable without ground truth leakage
receiver-local point-support density at object or cell level before fusion
actual YAML object/track identities and their stability across vehicle-only, UAV-only, and cooperative outputs
sequence-level manifest with enough non-overlapping route diversity
receiverObservableRestriction.leakageRisk: High if occlusion strata are defined from post-fusion ground truth visibility, UAV-only returns, final detector errors, or object labels unavailable before the cooperation decision.

syncAsyncRealityCheck.finding: Sync is tied to hardware synchronization and nearest timestamps; async is synthetic temporal displacement. Any claim about real network congestion, packet loss, or deployment delay distribution is unsupported.

registeredStrata.name: occlusion
registeredStrata.sequenceLevelSupport: No public sequence-level count by occlusion bin was verified. Paper-level occlusion analysis does not provide enough independent sequence support for a confirmatory interaction.

registeredStrata.name: distance
registeredStrata.sequenceLevelSupport: Distance is already analyzed by the original paper and may only be a covariate/control or baseline rule.

registeredStrata.name: return-density-or-point-support
registeredStrata.sequenceLevelSupport: Raw point clouds make a receiver-local point-support measure plausible, but no public sequence-level bin counts or balance across train/validation/test were verified.

registeredStrata.name: sync-async
registeredStrata.sequenceLevelSupport: Sync/async is publicly reported by the paper. The async condition is synthetic delay and cannot be a new natural-delay stratum.

jointStrataSparsity.finding: With only 9 validation and 9 test sequences, even two binary residual strata crossed with distance and sync/async controls can create cells with too few independent sequences or empty confirmation cells.
jointStrataSparsity.minimumAcceptableLedgerBeforeOutcome: Before outcome inspection, a support table must list sequence counts per residual occlusion/point-support stratum, split, distance bin, and sync/async condition. Fewer than 6 independent confirmation sequences in any primary cell is an immediate descriptive-support stop, but 6 is not a power approval; the final total must also meet the predeclared effect-size calculation. Any leave-one-sequence-out sign flip must stop the candidate.

developmentConfirmationSplit.finding: The official non-training split is 9 validation plus 9 test sequences. A conventional validation-as-development design leaves 9 independent test sequences. All 18 may be used as one confirmatory set only if strata, thresholds, metric, and model-selection rules are frozen without inspecting the new residual outcomes; the same 18 cannot serve both discovery and confirmation.

notNew: distance main effect or distance-only switching
aggregate cooperative benefit over single-agent baselines
coveredByOriginalPaper.onlyPermittedResidual: After controlling distance and synthetic time shift, a pre-fusion receiver-observable occlusion/point-support conditional value that changes the collaboration admission decision.

pairedLedgerEstimand.definition: For each sequence i, compute D_i = metric_i(cooperative) - metric_i(vehicle_only), optionally also U_i = metric_i(cooperative) - metric_i(UAV_only). The residual primary estimand is an interaction or contrast in D_i between pre-registered receiver-observable occlusion/point-support strata after controlling distance and synthetic time shift. For a within-sequence stratum contrast, n is the number of independent sequences contributing eligible observations to both sides of that contrast, never the number of frames or objects, so usable n may be below 9 or 18.

formula.pairedMeanApproximation: n_required = ((z_(1-alpha/2) + z_power) * sigma_D / Delta)^2, equivalently n_required = ((z_(1-alpha/2) + z_power) / d_z)^2 where d_z = Delta / sigma_D.
formula.notes: This is an optimistic normal approximation for sequence-level paired differences. It does not use frame or object counts. It becomes anti-conservative if sequence deltas are non-normal, if strata are selected after seeing outcomes, or if multiple metrics/strata are tested without correction.

assumptions.variancePolicy: No variance is fabricated. Results are stated as standardized effect d_z or as a required pilot estimate of sigma_D from development sequences only.

sensitivity.interpretation: The 9-sequence confirmation split only has 80% power for very large sequence-level paired effects.

sensitivity.scenario: single uncorrected contrast using all non-training sequences, not valid for discovery plus confirmation
sensitivity.interpretation: Using all 18 non-training sequences improves power only if the residual protocol was frozen before inspecting those outcomes; the same data cannot both tune strata and confirm them.

sensitivity.scenario: Holm or Bonferroni first-step correction for four pre-registered strata/tests
sensitivity.interpretation: Four-way strata auditing on 9 confirmation sequences requires an implausibly large standardized sequence-level interaction.
A medium effect requires about 32 independent sequences before multiplicity and cluster complications.
A large effect still exceeds the 9-sequence confirmation split.
Small residual interactions are not estimable with this public split.

clusterCorrelationAudit.finding: Frames and objects inside the same acquisition sequence are correlated through route, weather, scene geometry, sensor calibration, model checkpoint, and object composition. Treating 53984 frames or 700K boxes as independent would be pseudoreplication.

multipleComparisonAudit.finding: The requested occlusion, distance, return density, and sync/async strata, plus vehicle-only/UAV-only/cooperative comparisons and AP/recall/error outcomes, create a family of tests. The residual must be reduced to one primary occlusion or point-support interaction before confirmation, with distance and sync/async as controls.

powerVerdict.finding: The strict 9-sequence confirmation design is underpowered even for a standardized effect of 0.8, while an externally frozen 18-sequence design still detects only effects around d_z=0.66 before multiplicity and stratum imbalance. No public sequence-level variance or support table justifies a smaller n.

canSelfTrainOrImplementEvaluator.finding: The task permits self-training vehicle-only, UAV-only, and cooperative baselines and implementing an evaluator. The fixed source tree provides a plausible implementation base, but self-training does not solve missing sample-level ledger closure, sequence-level support, and power requirements.

minimumExecutablePathIfRevised: Fetch only official Hugging Face YAML metadata or one minimal sequence sample, not the full 95 GB dataset.

Run the fixed commit loader on that sample and verify actual split entries, timestamp tolerance, object/track identities, sync/async behavior, and sequence-level output export for vehicle-only, UAV-only, and one cooperative configuration.

Build a pre-outcome manifest with sequence id, split, scene/route, vehicle timestamps, UAV timestamps, agent availability, candidate object or track ids, distance bins, synthetic delay bins, receiver-local point-support bins, and receiver-observable occlusion bins.
Freeze exactly one primary residual interaction and one primary metric on validation or external development sequences.
Confirm once on held-out sequences with sequence-cluster intervals and leave-one-sequence-out diagnostics.
notAllowedAsEvidence: Claims that synthetic async is a measured network-delay distribution.
Using repository existence or README claims as a substitute for loader/config/output verification.

successConditions: An official Hugging Face YAML/sample is run through the source-verified fixed commit e099a3a746c6092a614e18b74d1f5b2f3c8351e8 without downloading the full dataset.
A pre-outcome manifest proves that vehicle-only, UAV-only, and cooperative outputs can be paired by the same sequence, scene, timestamp or accepted timestamp tolerance, and object/track identity.
Residual occlusion or point-support strata are defined solely from receiver-observable pre-fusion fields and have adequate independent sequence support in the confirmation split.
Distance and synthetic sync/async are controls or baseline rules, not claimed as new findings.
A single primary residual interaction has enough sequence-level power under a predeclared sigma_D estimate or a justified minimum detectable effect.
The residual changes a predeclared collaboration admission decision relative to always-collaborate, never-collaborate, and distance/sync baseline rules.
killConditions: Public fields remain insufficient to verify same sequence/scene/timestamp/object pairing across vehicle-only, UAV-only, and cooperative arms.
Occlusion or return-density strata cannot be defined before fusion from receiver-observable fields.
The effective confirmation sample remains 9 sequences under validation-as-development, or at most 18 under a fully frozen protocol, and the planned residual interaction remains underpowered.
Any claimed result depends on treating frames or object boxes as independent samples.
The residual disappears after controlling distance, synthetic time shift, scene, or object class.
The result is distance-only, sync/async-only, or an aggregate cooperative benefit already covered by the original paper.
A leave-one-sequence-out analysis changes the sign or decision consequence of the residual.
No public variance or development-only sigma_D estimate supports the planned minimum detectable effect.

risks.description: The fixed GitHub source tree, README, and base loader were independently verified, but the Hugging Face tree request timed out and no actual YAML/sample, checkpoint payload, sequence-level three-arm output, or runtime execution was verified.

The fixed loader says timestamp stems are mocked and assumes equal timestamp lengths across CAVs. Without an actual sequence sample, matching numeric stems do not prove physical timestamp tolerance, missing-frame handling, or unbiased vehicle/UAV pairing.

The supplement enumerates sequences, but no sampled manifest establishes how many independent routes, sites, weather regimes, or acquisition sessions remain after grouping correlated sequences. Effective inferential n could therefore be lower than the nominal sequence count.
The public split table has only 9 validation and 9 test sequences, so sequence-level confirmation has low power for residual interactions.
Occlusion, return density, distance, and sync/async strata jointly fragment the already small independent sequence count.
Occlusion labels can easily leak ground truth or UAV information unless the stratum is computed strictly from vehicle-side pre-fusion observations.
Distance and sync/async are already reported in the original paper. The only possible residual is occlusion/point-support conditional value after controlling them.
The async condition is synthetic temporal displacement and does not justify claims about natural wireless latency, congestion, or packet loss.

verdict.reason: The precheck fails the required sequence-support and statistical-power gate. Public paper evidence verifies only 42 listed sequences with 9 validation and 9 test sequences, while the residual requires receiver-observable occlusion/point-support interactions after controlling distance and artificial (0, 1000] ms delay. A strict development/confirmation design has n=9; even a fully frozen protocol using all 18 non-training sequences has an optimistic uncorrected minimum detectable effect near d_z=0.66 before stratum imbalance. The fixed GitHub source verifies that a three-arm evaluator is implementable, but no actual Hugging Face YAML/sample, per-sequence three-arm output ledger, checkpoint runtime, or public sequence-by-stratum support table closes the evidentiary gap. Engineering self-training or evaluator implementation therefore does not cure the support and power failures.
verdict.allowedFutureRevision: A future revision may reopen only if small official metadata or samples prove same sequence/scene/timestamp/object pairing, pre-fusion receiver-observable residual strata, adequate confirmation sequence support, and a development-only variance estimate showing 80% power for one predeclared residual interaction.
